abstract: The beta-subunit of human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) and pregnancy-specific beta 1-glycoprotein (SP1) were measured simultaneously by specific radioimmunoassays in 473 serum samples from 43 patients with trophoblastic tumors. Both SP1 and hCG values were high in 16 untreated patients. 27 patients had been treated previously elsewhere, and their further treatment and monitoring were started simultaneously in our institute. Raised SP2 and hCG levels were found in 22 and 21 cases, respectively. Treatment was followed by a parallel decrease of both SP1 and hCG, but the hCG decline was more marked. Seronegativity was reached only after several months; SP1 was present in the serum for 60-150 days, and hCG could be found even after this time. Both parameters were sensitive indicators of residual tumor activity, calling for further therapy months before any clinical manifestation of recurrence. In three cases only one of the tumor makers could be found, which underlines the importance of the simultaneous measurement of hCG and SP1.
abstract_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍の患者43例から採取した血清473検体について、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニット(hCG)と妊娠特異的β1-グリコプロテイン(SP1)を、特異的ラジオイムノアッセイで同時に測定した。未治療の患者16例では、SP1とhCGの値はともに高値であった。27例は他施設で既に治療を受けており、当施設でさらなる治療とモニタリングが同時に開始された。SP1の上昇は22例、hCGの上昇は21例で認められた。治療に伴い、SP1とhCGは並行して低下したが、hCGの低下はより顕著であった。血清陰性化が得られるまでには数か月を要した。SP1は血清中に60~150日間残存し、hCGはそれ以上の期間でも検出可能であった。両マーカーは、臨床的な再発の数か月前から残存腫瘍活動性の鋭敏な指標となり、追加治療の必要性を示した。3例では片方のマーカーのみが検出され、hCGとSP1の同時測定の重要性が示された。
